senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sounded, sounding.
2 Inflated.
3 Burnt.
m. (-तः)
1 Flatulence, borborygmi, swelling of the abdomen with noise.
2 War, battle.
E.
आङ् before ध्मा to blow, affix क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Blowing, inflation.
2 A bellows.
3 Intumescence, swelling of the belly, dropsy.
E.
आङ् before ध्मा to blow, and ल्युट् aff.
